- Contributors

- License"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What It Does"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This plugin makes DeepSeek Harness show the model **only the sandbox escalation options that the cur"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rent session can actually use**."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"In an All Access session (`danger-full-access` + `never`), the stock DSH tools still advertise `sand"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"box_permissions` and `justification` on `bash`, `pwsh`, `write`, and `edit`. But in that state:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- the session is already at the highest sandbox mode, so no wider mode exists;
- the approval policy"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" is `never`, so every escalation request is rejected."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"When a model fills in those parameters, the call fails before it runs. The model may then retry with"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" different values and get stuck in a loop."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"This plugin projects the model-visible tool schema per session, based on the live Sandbox Mode and A"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"pproval Policy. It also adds a minimal execution-time fallback: it handles redundant same-mode reque"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"sts and, under `workspace-write`, removes a false `danger-full-access` request only from `write` / `"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"edit` calls whose resolved filesystem boundary is inside the current workspace."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## The Problem It Solves"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Models still see and send `sandbox_permissions` / `justification` in All Access sessions, so tools"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" fail before they run.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Why It Happens"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"DSH tools expose static escalation fields when they are registered, while the modes that can actuall"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"y be requested depend on each session's current Sandbox Mode and Approval Policy. The original model"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"-visible schema is not projected from that live session state before the request is built, so a mode"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"l can receive escalation parameters that cannot succeed. Tool validation then rejects those requests"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" before execution, which can start a retry loop."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`

- Operating systems: Windows (fully supported), Linux (verified on real Ubuntu 24.04), and "},{"id":"p25s8","text":"macOS (expected compatible — the plugin is pure JavaScript and the `.sh` scripts are POSIX — but not"},{"id":"p25s9","text":" yet tested on a real Mac). The plugin itself has no platform-specific code; actual sandbox enforcem"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"ent on Linux/macOS depends on the sandbox backends available to the DSH host (Linux: `bwrap` or a La"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"ndlock-enforcing kernel 5.13+; macOS: Seatbelt), probed at runtime by DSH itself. When no backend is"},{"id":"p25s12","text":" usable, DSH refuses to run the command rather than bypassing the sandbox. The plugin's permission p"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"rojection and argument normalization do not depend on any particular backend."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The plugin checks the installed DSH package versions at startup. Mixed installations through `0.1.6-"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"alpha.2` and unknown DSH versions fail explicitly. An initially visible target with partial escalati"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"on fields or an incompatible output definition rejects that Agent's registration; a target that omit"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"s both escalation fields is accepted as already safe. During runtime, a Preset restriction or stable"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" provider removal makes the wrapper dormant, while an incompatible replacement is isolated to that A"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"gent and target tool and reported without terminating the Host process. A later compatible definitio"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"n is wrapped automatically."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Why This Plugin"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### It won't modify or bypass DSH's security core"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`approveEscalation()` keeps its strictly-wider check, approval flow, and one-shot authorization sema"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ntics. The plugin only projects the model-visible surface and performs the narrow execution-time nor"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"malization described above:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- no removal of the strictly-wider check;
- no auto-approval when `approval=never`;
- no extra permi"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ssions;
- no changes to DSH installation or core packages."}],"truncated":true}
